reviews.text: Thank you so much to everyone but especially Dr Ury and the office manager Nicole. My baby was diagnosed with lymphoma at 3yrs old and passed a couple of months later. He was fighting so hard to breathe in that last week and they were so compassionate and kind, like went above and beyond, everything you could hope for from your vet when you’re going through something like this. ❤️
The vets here are very insightful and are clear with their clients! Highly reccomended!

I’ve been taking my dog ​​there for vaccinations and check-ups ever since I bought him two years ago. Yesterday, sept.2026, my dog ​​was feeling sick and needed an emergency check-up, but the receptionist told me I had to make an appointment. 🤦🏻‍♀️🤷🏻‍♀️ I got an appointment, but the traffic was terrible and I arrived a little late; I explained to the receptionist that my dog ​​needed to be seen urgently, and she told me *again* that I had to make an appointment. How the hell am I supposed to tell my dog ​​to just hang in there until he gets an appointment?
We appreciate your review! Thank you for trusting our team with your pet’s care. We look forward to seeing you again!
We sincerely value your 5-star rating. Your trust in Sheepshead Bay Veterinary Group means a lot to us.
Great veterinary office, good care and attention.  Expensive cist

Unprofessional! The manager, Nicole, been giving me false promises for 2.5 weeks that my dog’s medication will be ready for pick up and every time I called, they seem to never even ordered it, meanwhile he is coughing nonstop.  Heartless.

For me, they've been the best; they have an excellent team. I discovered this place because my son took his mother-in-law's dog there, and I was delighted with their service. Later, I remembered them when I needed a second opinion, as I wasn't satisfied with the care at Petco. I've come back here because of their kindness, gentleness, and the love they provide. My dog, Cookie, had surgery here, and the service was wonderful!

I’ve been coming to this hospital for many years. Without exception, my cats have received good care here. Stuff takes time to explain to me what needs to be done, they show me x-rays etc, and they treat my cats with care. After recent procedures I received a couple of follow up calls, and his instructions. I will continue to use this hospital.

Very kind reception desk Dr Moreno is fabulous, clean state of the art facility  Unlike Animal Hospital of Brooklyn 👎 rude management dingy smelly vet clinic. IM  FOR TEAM SHEEPSHEAD BAY VETERINARIAN GROUP! THX for your services. …

We tried to find a clinic closer to home, but SBVG is the best clinic in Brooklyn, so we keep going back there whenever our cats have health issues, despite the distance. Three weeks ago, our 11-year-old cat underwent complex surgery and is now recovering; we are hugely grateful to the doctors.

So comfortable place. My cats and my pom are so calm here. Doctor Sheinberg is the best. Thank you!
Update.
My pom got hip dislocation. They let me come without appointment, help my dog immediately.
Unfortunately, he needs some surgery, and they give us so reasonable price.
Thank you!

Over the years I've been through several vet clinics around Brooklyn and Staten Island area. So far, this is the best there is.
The wait time is close to none. The reception is always professional and caring.
My special thanks go to Dr. Yakov Sheynberg. Dr. Sheynberg not only has a ton of experience which is critical, but also is capable to explain the situation and necessary actions to pet owners. The examinations are thorough and treatments prescribed have been affective thus far.
Doctor or someone from his staff always follow up to check on treatment progress and pet condion.
I greatly appreciate this place!

This clinic is very nice and clean the receptionist are exceptional they go above and beyond the Dr.'s are very nice and understanding and their prices are very reasonable I've been with them for 3+yrs now and the both times I had emergencies for both my fur babies and the quality of care and the way they always make sure your fur babies get seen and taken care of is truly a blessing and the cherry on top is that they provide medications as well you don't have to go crazy thinking about where to get them filled and how long it will take you go home feeling 100% better and with ease in your mind they saved my puppy's eye I will forever be grateful and they saved my older fur baby when he had an allergic reaction and both times I was left extremely happy with the outcome I HIGHLY RECOMMEND 100/10 RUN DON'T WALK ITS THE BEST DECISION YOU WILL EVER MAKE❤️❤️

2026 Update:

It’s been at least 5–6 years since my last visit. The cat I mentioned in my previous review has sadly passed away over the past 2–3 years due to old age.

Recently, I adopted a new cat, and since this clinic is the closest to my home, I decided to bring my newly adopted cat here for a check-up.

This time, the experience felt completely different. Over the years, it seems the front desk staff I previously had issues with are no longer there. The current receptionists are gentle, attentive, and very patient. The doctors and nurses remain as professional as ever, which gives us much more confidence in the clinic.

We have several cats now, and we will continue choosing this clinic for their regular check-ups.

Previous review:

Not recommend. Vets are nice and friendly, but the front desk ladies didn't care about you and your pets. They lost my cat's blood, so they told a lie to ask us do the blood test again for comparing the difference. They gave us some food sample but My pet is a cat, she gave me the dog food.

Quite possibly the worst visit I’ve had at a Vet, and I once brought a cat in to be spayed who died under anesthesia. A few weeks ago, I brought my cat in to have her ears cleaned. We were seen by Dr. Yuri (spelling may be incorrect). The Vet Tech was great. Dr. Yuri was not. I explained the situation in detail and Dr. Yuri proceeded to mildly clean my cat’s ear. After cleaning for all of ten seconds, he asked if we wanted to run tests for further diagnosis, which we politely declined. It was then that his demeanor changed completely. He said he would get us medicine, and left the room. I was flabbergasted. After demanding to see him again, I explained only two options would suffice. Either he could clean the ear which is what I brought my cat in for, or we could leave without paying and go to VEG who has cleaned her ear easily prior. He then proceeded to clean the ear again but only after I made my request, and it wasn’t even cleaned properly or fully. The Dr. treated the practice like a car lot, and if you’re not willing to pay for the bells and whistles, he really couldn’t be bothered. It’s a shame because it’s in my neighborhood but I’ll never return and would never recommend this practice.
